title: Original ANT contribution through materially useful PVG
deliverable: One original correct modest ANT theorem in which PVG contributes materially
exit_criterion: Certified original theorem or explicit strategic revision
claim_ceiling: No theorem until proof and literature certificates

title: Master bidirectional PVG ANT translation
deliverable: Reusable language kernel with exact bridges, loss audits, and analytic transforms
exit_criterion: Kernel reaches certified ASSIM-L3 coverage on its declared core

title: Build an original lemma and theorem pipeline
deliverable: Originality-audited lemma selection and one-theorem program
exit_criterion: At least one certified original lemma and theorem attempt closure
claim_ceiling: No originality claim before literature and proof gates

title: Close scale-heterogeneity diagnostic and proof-strategy pass
deliverable: Reproducible report, generated certificate, exact identity layer, empirical pattern layer, and named analytic gap
exit_criterion: Repair, CI, closure review, and merge or negative certificate

title: Release PVG ANT Language Kernel v1
deliverable: Eight canonical bridges with forward/reverse maps, loss, transform, gain, examples, and certificates
exit_criterion: Kernel audit passes and declared bridge set is reusable
claim_ceiling: Exact translation and certified structural gains only

title: Select one serious original lemma target
deliverable: Ten candidates, literature triage, three finalists, one frozen lemma target

title: Execute the first one-theorem program
deliverable: Proof, negative certificate, known-classical-consequence closure, or named missing certificate
claim_ceiling: Original lemma/theorem only after proof and literature certificates

title: Formal and publication closure
deliverable: Final literature audit, manual proof, optional Lean certificate, adversarial review, and manuscript
exit_criterion: Reviewable manuscript or publication-level negative assessment
claim_ceiling: Publication claim only after full certificates
